items.guidance: Wekan is a Meteor app, so if a server-side route mechanism exists (for example WebApp.connectHandlers or a server router), register the route there so it bypasses client routing and login. Make sure it answers on port 8080 at the exact path configured as the Deployz health check path, and report that path.

Check whether the server reads MONGO_URL at startup and whether the collections are defined through the Meteor/Mongo data layer on runtime paths, not only in tests or scripts. If both are true, MongoDB is the core datastore rather than an optional integration. Report the files that show this and the MONGO_URL requirement, then stop.
